regime_context: Detector shows a narrowing eligible set (19/49 themes), with AI Infrastructure as the clear leader (score 1.98, durability 0.68, not crowded) and Cybersecurity as the only close challenger (1.638, but crowded at z=1.8). Trend gate is helpful (gate_helps: true), so drawdown control has worked on this market's history, but relative momentum has no forward edge and track record shows direction accuracy near coin-flip (0.483) — so this is a discipline/humility regime, not a conviction regime.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Cybersecurity's crowded flag (z=1.8) resolves via a durable breakout above its 20-day high on expanding breadth — that would retire the crowding caution and upgrade it to a stronger trend lean; if CIBR instead makes a lower high while AI Infrastructure keeps leading, the crowding read stands.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only theme combining top-2 rank with the strongest durability signature in the dataset (durability_bar 0.85, the highest of any scorable theme) and perfect breadth (1.0), plus a clean 'trend' Hurst tag. The crowding flag (z=1.8) is a size-down caution per guardrails, not a fade — but the trend-gate leg supports staying with it absent an absolute-trend break.
evidence: gate_helps true — trend discipline valid on this market
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.8 is the single highest in the ranks; if attention/flow spikes mark tops (as the backtest warns), this is precisely where a mean-revert unwind could hit hard even if the underlying trend is intact.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex (rank 4, eligible) shows a clean 'trend' Hurst tag with solid breadth (0.727) and positive-but-not-extreme crowding (z=0.83), and is the highest-ranked non-AI/tech theme. The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge here, and this theme passes it — making it the most defensible diversifier away from the crowded AI/tech cluster.
theses.dissent: Energy is a macro-beta sector; if the dominant macro narrative (markets/geopolitics, 75% unscheduled share) turns risk-off, Energy's trend status will not protect it and it may fall faster than defensives.

falsifier.text: XLE relative to SPY turns negative over a rolling 10-day window

theses.subject: Housing Chain
theses.thesis: Housing Chain sits at rank 47 with the most negative crowding z (-1.31) and score -1.085, and is ineligible. The trend-gate leg is the one validated edge, and this theme clearly fails it — no reason to hold it through a drawdown-prone regime.
theses.dissent: Extreme negative crowding and zero breadth can sometimes mark exhaustion; a sharp rate-cut surprise could catalyze a violent mean-revert bounce that catches this avoid call wrong.

falsifier.text: XHB rises more than 8% in any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
